technical_correction: Before any scaleout pixel was opened, the first Linux validation showed that the ROI-v4 parent used platform-dependent exact working-tree bytes. Parent identities are therefore declared as LF-canonical text hashes; no data, feature, cohort, scale, gate, statistic or outcome rule changed.
objective: convert the complete location-blind ROI-v4 measurements into species-conditioned transition surfaces and test their concordance with independently frozen environmental boundaries across eight random species cohorts

input_gate.roi_requirement: exact committed pass_roi_v4_locked_test result and matching trained-weight SHA-256
input_gate.measurement_requirement: pass_scaleout_measurement_completeness over all 60000 frozen measurement IDs
input_gate.coordinate_opening_rule: join the sealed coordinate key only after measurement completeness passes; never expose coordinates to a measurement worker
input_gate.failed_rule: return not_evaluable and keep coordinates sealed

colour_vectors.standardization: within each species and surface role, subtract the component median and divide by the component interquartile range over the complete admitted analysis subset
colour_vectors.zero_iqr_rule: set a zero-IQR component to zero after centering; if all three components have zero IQR, that species-configuration is not_evaluable
colour_vectors.background_subset: the admitted observations with background_features_available=true and all three finite background means
colour_vectors.background_role: a multiplicity-protected camera-and-scene diagnostic that conditions wording but cannot create or erase the primary flower outcome

transition_surface.species_conditioning: construct every graph, transform and edge rank separately within species
transition_surface.edge_score: RMS Euclidean distance across the three robust-standardized Lab components
transition_surface.edge_intensity: within-species zero-to-one average rank with exact ties and 0.5 for a single retained edge
transition_surface.cell_value: mean intensity of retained edge midpoints in the equal-area cell
transition_surface.cohort_surface: equal-species mean across every detectable species in a cell
transition_surface.opportunity_weight: number of detectable species in that cohort and cell
transition_surface.failed_primary_cohort_rule: the environmental branch is not_evaluable; never select the remaining cohorts
transition_surface.failed_sensitivity_rule: retain that sensitivity as not_evaluable without closing an otherwise evaluable primary analysis

season_configurations.rule: build the same geometry-only k-nearest-neighbour candidates, then retain only edges whose endpoints share the declared metadata season label before applying the distance cap

environmental_families.missing_cells: use only finite flower-opportunity and finite overlay cells for that exact test; never convert missing values to zero or repair them from distant environmental cells

joint_inference.method: weighted Moran eigenvector coefficient-sign randomization after the frozen seven-column broad geographic detrending
joint_inference.cohort_combination: for each role, environmental surface, scale and season configuration, average the eight cohort residual correlations with equal cohort weight
joint_inference.familywise_null: on each randomization independently sign-randomize the flower or background coefficients within every cohort-test basis, then take one maximum over every cohort statistic and every equal-cohort statistic across both surface roles, all three scales, all season configurations and every primary or sensitivity environmental surface
joint_inference.primary_promotion_tests: only equal-eight-cohort flower statistics at 100 km, all_dates, and the three primary environmental surfaces
joint_inference.supported: at least one primary promotion test has familywise adjusted p<=0.05
joint_inference.not_supported: all three primary promotion tests are evaluable and have familywise adjusted p>0.05
joint_inference.not_evaluable: an input gate, primary cohort, macroclimate coverage or two-family environmental coverage requirement fails
joint_inference.reporting: report every cohort correlation, equal-cohort correlation, adjusted p-value, sensitivity, failure and terminal branch outcome

background_wording.background_primary_supported: describe a scene-nonspecific camera-space concordance and do not call it flower-specific
background_wording.background_primary_not_supported: describe flower-candidate concordance without a detected background counterpart, while retaining the camera-space and noncausal ceiling
background_wording.background_not_evaluable: state that background confounding could not be evaluated

visualization.map: species-free points rendered from unstandardized admitted flower mean Lab colour after the sealed join
visualization.photo_bar: species-free licensed flower-candidate crops or full images ordered only by a frozen spatial axis; taxon labels remain absent from the display
visualization.inference_table: species-conditioned and cohort-labelled; never pool observations across taxa before transition construction

claim_ceiling: A supported result is spatial concordance between automated camera-space flower-candidate colour transitions and independently frozen environmental transitions across random species cohorts. It is not a universal boundary, calibrated reflectance, pollinator vision, visitation, adaptation, selection or causation.
